hadiths.name: Hadith 1
hadiths.text: Actions are judged by intentions, and every person will get the reward according to what he has intended.

hadiths.name: Hadith 2
hadiths.text: The best among you are those who have the best manners and character.

hadiths.name: Hadith 3
hadiths.text: None of you will have faith till he wishes for his brother what he likes for himself.

hadiths.name: Hadith 4
hadiths.text: Make things easy, not difficult, and give glad tidings and do not drive people away.

hadiths.name: Hadith 5
hadiths.text: The strong person is not the one who can wrestle well but the one who controls himself when angry.

hadiths.name: Hadith 6
hadiths.text: A good word is charity. Every step taken towards prayer is charity.

hadiths.name: Hadith 7
hadiths.text: Smiling at your brother is charity, enjoining good is charity, and forbidding evil is charity.

hadiths.name: Hadith 8
hadiths.text: The most beloved deed to Allah is the most regular and constant even if it were little.

hadiths.name: Hadith 9
hadiths.text: Seek knowledge from the cradle to the grave.

hadiths.name: Hadith 10
hadiths.text: The best of you are those who learn the Quran and teach it.

hadiths.name: Hadith 12
hadiths.text: Do not look down upon any good deed, even meeting your brother with a cheerful face.
